quote: the university explicitly prohibits the development, deployment, or integration of agentic AI systems
what_it_says: Institutional ban on developing or deploying agentic AI (organisational, not student use); only partly held by delegate_to_ai_agent.

quote: we will invest in the development of AI literacy skills for everyone to understand how to use these tools responsibly and effectively.
what_it_says: Planned AI literacy development for 'everyone'; audience and form unclear, not coded as support.

quote: If you skip this dropbox, you can submit the assignment but it won't have an attached declaration, which may be reported.
what_it_says: Skipping the declaration still allows submission but may be reported; fits no consequence value.

quote:
Students and staﬀ are not permitted to upload student
assessments or any identiﬁable data to AI applications for any reason (this includes attempts
to check for AI generated content).
what_it_says: Upload ban incl. checking for AI content; data_or_upload_breach already held under 8.10 so one row per value.

quote: In-person assessments such as exams, in-class tests and purely practical assessments do not require an AI Declaration to be submitted.
what_it_says: Declaration not required for in-person exams, tests and practical assessments (exempt by assessment type; no exempt value fits).

quote: If the assessment brief does not explicitly mention the use of AI tools including generative AI, you should adhere to the Supporting Good Academic Practice Policy.
what_it_says: Default when brief is silent is to follow another policy; no default_when_silent value fits.

quote: Do not upload university-sensitive data into AI tools unless you have been given permission by academic staff.
what_it_says: Data upload rule (intellectual property, personal information, research data) needing staff permission; data vocabulary, not uses.

quote: Inappropriate or unethical use of AI in recruitment contexts may result in:
what_it_says: Recruitment misuse can lead to disqualification or withdrawal of job offers; non-academic outcome with no outcome value.

quote: Be aware of environmental impact. Each AI query uses energy. Combine your questions into one well-thought-out prompt to reduce your digital footprint.
what_it_says: Advises reducing AI's environmental footprint by combining prompts; no use or value fits.

quote: If in doubt, assume that AI cannot be used in your assessment task.
what_it_says: Default prohibit_all is already coded; no new value.

quote: HW will keep under review developments on generative AI detection tools.
what_it_says: Commitment to review AI detection tools; no stance value fits.

quote: Students accept that they are wholly responsible for ensuring the veracity, accuracy and/or creative merit of the output generated by any artificial intelligence model.
what_it_says: Student accountability for AI output accuracy; no liability value fits cleanly.

quote: we recommend using University-supported AI tools rather than external alternatives.
what_it_says: Recommends institution-provided AI tools over external ones (tool rule, no use value).

quote: Staff and students should not engage in the following prohibited AI practices under Article 5 of the EU AI Act.
what_it_says: Lists EU AI Act prohibited practices (academic misconduct, privacy breaches, surveillance, bias, IP infringement) as things not to do; a regulatory list that fits no single use value.

quote: Students must not upload any University of Manchester owned materials, including lecture – recordings, slides, question papers, handouts or any other copyrighted resources to external AI tools.
what_it_says: Bans uploading university-owned materials to external AI tools (data/tool rule, no offence stated).

quote: You should not upload content to Generative AI tools, or social media platforms, without the permission of the copyright holder.
what_it_says: Copyright upload rule; no offence or sanction stated.

quote: I certify that I have not used any Generative Artificial Intelligence tools in the preparation of this work.
what_it_says: Cover-sheet declaration option of no AI use; not a rule on use.

quote: Article 50 of the EU AI Act came into force in August 2026.
what_it_says: Legal transparency obligation to disclose AI-generated content; no misconduct or consequence value fits.

quote: The burden of proof rests with the ICR.
what_it_says: Burden of proof lies with the institution; no process value for burden (only standard_of_proof).

quote: You should be aware of AI’s negative environmental impact, due to the large amount of energy consumed by AI systems.
what_it_says: Students should be aware of AI's environmental impact; no use or condition value fits.

quote: Comparing content developed by Gen AI to that developed by a human
what_it_says: Listed use of comparing AI output with human-written content; no matching use id.

quote: You must receive consent before entering work created by others into the AI tool as a prompt.
what_it_says: Consent needed before entering others' work into an AI tool (data/upload rule, no use or offence value fits).

quote: Conducting research without the required ethical approval and/or other relevant permissions.
what_it_says: Research ethics breach listed as misconduct; not AI-related and no offence value fits.

quote: Secure and always protect their work, including from unsolicited capture for AI training purposes by online AI providers.
what_it_says: Students must protect their work from capture for AI training; a data/tool rule with no vocabulary slot.

quote: The University does not endorse or permit the use of any Artificial Intelligence detection tools or services to determine if the unauthorised use of Generative AI has taken place, and does not permit the submission of students' work to these tools or services.
what_it_says: Students' work may not be submitted to AI detection tools (a data/tool rule); detection side already coded as not_used.

quote: RCSI reserves the right to avail of any technological or other means available to it to detect academic misconduct in respect of any assessment or other academic activity undertaken by any of its students.
what_it_says: Reserves right to use unspecified technological means to detect misconduct; no method named.

quote: Include elements for students to record their individual pathways of thinking, demonstrating students own work. ePortfolios are good examples of requiring students to record their individual pathways of thinking.
what_it_says: Staff-facing assessment design advice (viva, staged drafts, oral assessment) to design out GenAI; prevention not detection, not coded.

quote: unauthorised and / or unacknowledged use of paraphrasing or translation software to, for example, disguise plagiarism, collusion, contract cheating or other academic integrity breach.
what_it_says: Unacknowledged paraphrasing/translation software use is an integrity breach (not coded as translate row: AI not clearly named).

quote: We urge staff and students not to upload student assignments/assessments to any websites or tools to check for AI use.
what_it_says: Staff and students urged not to upload student work to AI-checking tools (data rule, no fitting misconduct value).

quote: Academic misconduct will not appear on the student’s transcript.
what_it_says: Misconduct findings are kept off the transcript (no outcome value fits).

quote: It is noted that the UCD Plagiarism Tariff is not appropriate for guiding penalties in relation to other categories of academic misconduct, such as the unauthorised use of generative AI.
what_it_says: The plagiarism tariff does not apply to unauthorised generative AI use (tariff_or_factors key already used).

quote: for many of your assessments (and unless otherwise stated), there will be a strict expectation that any use of generative AI in the production of work you submit will adhere to University policy regarding false authorship.
what_it_says: Default when brief silent is a strict expectation of no false authorship; fits no default_when_silent value.

quote: Using Gen AI in a way that would bring BPP or its clients into disrepute.
what_it_says: Misuse of AI that brings the institution or clients into disrepute is a potential misconduct breach (no matching offence value).

quote: Any student suspected of using AI in such a presentation will have their application refused, their visa turned down or simply be failed at the test.
what_it_says: Stated consequences for suspected AI use in presentations (refused application, visa, fail); no exact outcome value.

quote: Apply University policies on data protection, privacy, and academic integrity when selecting and using approved academic work, ensuring responsible and ethical practice.
what_it_says: Data protection duty for AI use (data and tool rules vocabulary, not uses).

quote: This could lead to a fail, whether or not plagiarism can be demonstrated.
what_it_says: Heavy use of AI text in a research thesis risks failing the viva; a failed viva fits no outcome value exactly (not module failure).

quote: The University does not recommend or endorse any specific GenAI tools.
what_it_says: The institution endorses no specific GenAI tool; no tool-stance value exists.

quote: Students and staff always remain accountable for their final outputs.
what_it_says: Individual accountability for outputs; no liability value fits cleanly.

quote: Students and staff are each individually responsible for their use of Gen AI and are accountable for the outputs and outcomes created.
what_it_says: Individual responsibility for AI use and outputs; no liability value fits cleanly.

quote: Teachers/ assessors should not rely solely on AI tools for marking student work, as per JCQ guidelines.
what_it_says: Staff-only duty on AI-assisted marking; outside student vocabularies.
